purpose: Teach: 本紙/減速/同市/出馬/課せ/部類/大綱/適性

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本紙の社外向け記事を社内報にも転載しましょう
lines.en: Let's republish our external article in the internal newsletter too.
lines.style: Efficient and matter-of-fact. Quick attack on the opening. Clear instruction, no hesitation. Professional pace, forward-moving energy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。生産ラインを減速する必要が出てきました
lines.en: Understood. The production line is going to need to slow down.
lines.style: Acknowledging and straightforward. Light pause after the agreement. Delivering information evenly, not dramatizing. Steady, supportive tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 同市内の競合店をリストアップしましょう
lines.en: Let's get a list together of competitors in the same area.
lines.style: Clear directive, slight snap to it. Businesslike, expects action. Not harsh—just organized and purposeful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の代表が選挙に出馬されたそうです
lines.en: Understood. I heard one of our major clients' representatives is running for office.
lines.style: Neutral reporting voice. Delivers the fact without spin. Slight lift at the end—noting relevance. Professional but human.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人に厳しい目標を課せると逆効果ですね
lines.en: Pushing too hard on the new staff might actually backfire, don't you think?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant. Inviting agreement rather than stating certainty. Soft on the question mark. The tone of someone working through an idea aloud.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の問い合わせは緊急の部類です
lines.en: Understood. Inquiries from our major clients fall into the urgent category.
lines.style: Clear, factual confirmation. Emphasizing the priority weight. Steady rhythm. Not alarmed, but making sure the importance lands.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新方針の大綱を社員に発表しましょう
lines.en: Let's announce the key points of our new policy to the team.
lines.style: Clear and purposeful. Takes charge without being sharp. Even pacing, confident. The tone of someone who has thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。配属には個々の適性を考慮します
lines.en: Understood. We'll take each person's strengths into account when assigning roles.
lines.style: Supportive and considered. Finishing note—settling in with care. Warm undertone, showing the thinking behind the plan.
